text: A muscular male figure, likely late teens to early adulthood, with dark brown skin. Long black hair flows down his back. Face is angular, eyes narrow, mouth set in a grimace. He wears a tight-fitting loincloth and armored belt, with knee-high boots. Clutches a large axe. Stands front-facing, legs slightly apart. Behind him, another identical figure faces away. Both have horns atop heads. Text annotations detail materials and weights for costume elements.
